dossier.key_finding: Anatoly F. Okhatrin (1925-2002, deputy dir. science NPO Krasnaya zvezda, nuclear-space; late-80s IMGRE biolocation lab) + patent RU 2159009 (OOO MT-Mikroleptonika, 1998/2000): cone ML-resonator (~0.7 MHz), channel between IDENTICAL resonators, four MCS rigs with named instruments (ChS-43 counter, GNU-KS gravimeter, SRP-2/Anri-01-02 dosimeters, S-106 oscilloscope). KEY QC rows: (1) the PHOTO-WITNESS channel ('natural channel between an object and its image') is in a granted Russian patent - same doctrine as the fr radionics school (de la Warr/Drown/Bersez), two traditions converging independently; (2) the gravimeter headline 5.7e-6 g ('850 t at 1 m') sits at ~1.4x the rms error of the ballistic gravimeter run alongside it, and the patent itself explains the recovery as elastic-system drift - the mundane competitor explanation is IN the primary; (3) the dosimeter rows (photo of a Cs-137 ampoule 2 km away, -7/-10%; xenon lamps 20 km, +5.7%) are one-afternoon re-runnable with a photo-of-nothing control nobody has run in 28 years; (4) internal drift: Kc 6e-9 vs 1.65e-9, energy 1e9 vs 1e8 J/m3, 0.3 vs 0.7 MHz, Am-241/245; (5) Nobel-laundering row (Reines/Perl mangled as 'Rayks 1996, discovery of superlight particles'); (6) RU 2145104 Kovalev space-geology apex: $5,000/km2, 3x seismic savings, RAO Gazprom claim (1998) - cost-of-demonstration row; scout row CORRECTED: geostructure patent is RU 2145104, not RU 2138036; (7) Tatur's systematics claims the CURRY GRID is formed from microleptons - direct ru-lane claim on the earth-grids lane; (8) the torsion program (Akimov/Shipov) and the microlepton program cite each other into one cluster (RU 2145104/2140796 reference lists).
